text: Hey, Sandra, do you want to go to the movies tonight?
Maybe... what time?
How about the nine fifteen show?
Oh, that's too late for me... I usually go to bed at eight thirty.
So early?
Yeah.... I have to get up at five a.m. to study before school.
Five a.m.? Why don't you study at night?
I don't like to stay up late. I'm a morning person.
You look tired, John.
Yeah, well, I'm always tired.
Really? What time do you go to bed?
Usually around midnight. I like to stay up late. But I have to get up at six fifteen to go to work.
Do you want to go running tomorrow morning, Sam?
It depends... what time?
How about six o'clock?
Six o'clock? I don't get up until around nine thirty!
Wow, you get a lot of sleep!
Not really.... I usually stay up until about three in the morning.
Are you a morning person or a night person, Grace?
Oh, definitely a night person.
Really?
Yeah, I can't fall asleep before midnight. I usually go to bed around one a.m.
Huh. Do you sleep late in the morning?
Not really. I usually get up at a quarter to eight.
Did you watch the eleven o'clock news last night, Mia?
No... I was asleep. I usually go to bed around ten.
Ten o'clock? That's pretty early, isn't it?
Yeah, well, I'd like to stay up later... but I have to get up at six a.m. to go to work.
Hi, James, what's new?
Well, I got a new job a few weeks ago.
Really? Congratulations! How do you like it?
Well, it's great, except for the hours. I work the night shift.
Oh, no! When do you sleep?
Well, I go to bed at eight in the morning. I sleep all day, and get up at four in the afternoon.
